طلوا (form I)
# طَلُّوا (ṭallū) /tˤal.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of طَلَّ (ṭalla)
# طُلُّوا (ṭullū) /tˤul.luː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of طَلَّ (ṭalla)
# طِلُّوا (ṭillū) /tˤil.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of طَلَّ (ṭalla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
